<!-- PumOrga Hygiene 0.9.13 · Hygieneplan & Arbeitsanweisungen zur Hygiene · ohne Zugangssperre (Zugang regelt die Kurs-/Seitenfreigabe) -->
<style>
#hygienewerk-app .hw-bar{display:none;justify-content:flex-end;margin:0 0 6px}
#hygienewerk-app .hw-fs{font:600 14px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;color:#fff;background:#1f8c6f;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 16px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
#hygienewerk-app .hw-fs:hover{background:#18735b}
#hygienewerk-app.hw-full{position:fixed!important;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;background:#f3f7f4;margin:0!important;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-sizing:border-box}
#hygienewerk-app.hw-full #hw-frame{flex:1 1 auto;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;border-radius:10px!important}
#hygienewerk-app:fullscreen{background:#f3f7f4;padding:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-sizing:border-box}
#hygienewerk-app:fullscreen #hw-frame{flex:1 1 auto;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important}
@media print{#hygienewerk-app .hw-bar{display:none!important}}
</style>
<div id="hygienewerk-app" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:0 auto">
<div class="hw-bar" id="hw-bar"><button type="button" class="hw-fs" id="hw-fs" aria-label="Vollbild ein- oder ausschalten">⛶ Vollbild</button></div>
<p id="hw-load" style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;padding:40px 16px;text-align:center;color:#16323a">PumOrga Hygiene wird geladen …</p>
<iframe id="hw-frame" title="PumOrga Hygiene" style="display:none;width:100%;height:88vh;min-height:640px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#f3f7f4" allow="clipboard-write"></iframe>
</div>
<script>
(async function(){var L=document.getElementById("hw-load"),F=document.getElementById("hw-frame");try{var b=atob(""),u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);
var t=await new Response(new Blob([u]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"))).text();
F.srcdoc=t;F.style.display="block";L.style.display="none";document.getElementById("hw-bar").style.display="flex";}catch(e){L.textContent="PumOrga Hygiene konnte nicht geladen werden. Bitte einen aktuellen Browser verwenden (Safari ab Version 16.4, Chrome, Edge oder Firefox).";}})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){var A=document.getElementById("hygienewerk-app"),B=document.getElementById("hw-fs"),F=document.getElementById("hw-frame"),css=false;
function isFs(){return css||document.fullscreenElement===A||document.webkitFullscreenElement===A}
function label(){B.textContent=isFs()?"✕ Vollbild beenden":"⛶ Vollbild"}
function lock(on){document.documentElement.style.overflow=on?"hidden":"";document.body.style.overflow=on?"hidden":""}
function enter(){var r=A.requestFullscreen||A.webkitRequestFullscreen;if(r){try{var p=r.call(A);if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){cssOn()});return}catch(e){}}cssOn()}
function cssOn(){css=true;A.classList.add("hw-full");lock(true);label()}
function exit(){if(css){css=false;A.classList.remove("hw-full");lock(false);label();return}var x=document.exitFullscreen||document.webkitExitFullscreen;if(x)x.call(document)}
B.addEventListener("click",function(){isFs()?exit():enter()});
document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange",label);document.addEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange",label);
function esc(e){if(e.key==="Escape"&&css)exit()}document.addEventListener("keydown",esc);
F.addEventListener("load",function(){try{F.contentWindow.document.addEventListener("keydown",esc)}catch(e){}});
})();
</script>
